meta.description: Registry for edge-case failure modes and required handling rules in the Mono-Process Formal Law Program.

failure_modes.name: unclassified_boundary_case
failure_modes.description: A process state maps to a boundary region with no registered classification or status.

failure_modes.name: boundary_case_suppression
failure_modes.description: Critical failure cases are hidden or ignored in the formal derivation trace.

failure_modes.name: window_collapse_unhandled
failure_modes.description: Formal rules fail when the admissibility window collapses to a null or degenerate set.

failure_modes.name: epsilon_flip_unhandled
failure_modes.description: Derivation fails to account for loci switching between null and non-null status under perturbation.

failure_modes.name: residue_drift_unbounded
failure_modes.description: Residue accumulation or loss exceeds the bounds required for stable theorem application.

failure_modes.name: orientation_drift_unbounded
failure_modes.description: Orientation frame shift exceeds the bounds required for coherent transport or minimization.

failure_modes.name: branch_explosion_unbounded
failure_modes.description: Branch proliferation violates the finite or conditionally finite bounds of the target law.

failure_modes.name: total_pruning_unhandled
failure_modes.description: Pruning eliminates all valid preimages or continuation paths without triggering a legal terminal state.

failure_modes.name: transport_closure_loss_unhandled
failure_modes.description: NavT transport leaves the declared local neighborhood without an explicit error or redirection rule.

failure_modes.name: empty_image_unhandled
failure_modes.description: The admissible image of an operator is empty, but existence is still asserted.

failure_modes.name: equivalence_failure_unhandled
failure_modes.description: Failure of reflexivity, symmetry, or transitivity in an equivalence relation goes undetected.
